{{Top|leg}}
'''Maleficent''' was a high-ranking title within the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] offshoot group known as the [[Sorcerers of Tund/Legends|Sorcerers of Tund]]. Those who held the rank were often addressed by their given name, followed by "the Maleficent." The only known holder of the title was the group's leader, [[Karnak Tetsu]].

==Behind the scenes==
The title of Maleficent was first mentioned in part 3 of the blog series [[The Imperial Warlords: Despoilers of an Empire]], in [[Cronal]]'s section relating to Karnak Tetsu. Abel G. Pena mentioned that he gave the rank because of it being a cool term for evil that he liked, and as a reference to Johnny Carson's psychic character routine named Carnac the Magnificent.<ref name="Pena PM">{{DMCite|dm=File:MaleficentMeaningKarnak-AbelGPena-Facebook.png|creator=[[Abel G. Peña]]|date=2014-01-27}}</ref>
